title: overbridge root config.yml
description: Settings that live outside the repos, at <OVERBRIDGE_ROOT>/config.yml. Each layer uses overbridge.yml's keys (see overbridge.schema.json), and any key may be left out because the layers merge. `overbridge config set <key> <value> [--repo name]` writes one value, such as defaults.ide zed, and refuses keys this schema and overbridge.schema.json do not describe.

agent.description: The coding agent a new workspace runs: claude (Claude Code, the default) or agy (Antigravity CLI). `overbridge start --agent` overrides it for one workspace, which keeps its agent from then on.

agent-rules.description: Rules that pick a new workspace's agent from its work item when `overbridge start` has no --agent. The first rule that matches wins; with none, `agent` applies. A rule matches when every criterion it sets matches, each by any of its values, ignoring case. Root-only. Builds older than the one that added it reject this key: remove it before downgrading.

agent.description: The agent a matching item's workspace runs.

priority.description: The item's priority name, such as Jira's Low. GitHub issues have no priority, so a rule with this never matches one.

labels.description: At least one of the item's labels.

parent.description: The id of any item above it: its epic or the epic's initiative, such as ENG-100 for Jira or owner/repo#42 for a GitHub parent issue, since the rules apply to every repo.

owners.description: Per GitHub owner (user or org, any case), matched against the remote URL of each repo in repos.toml: applied over defaults and under the repo's overbridge.yml.

repos.description: Per repo, by its name in repos.toml: applied over that repo's overbridge.yml.

skill-extensions.description: Directories of skill extension files (<dir>/<skill>/<phase>.md), read before the repo's .overbridge/ext. Absolute, ~/-relative or relative to the root.

agent-launch.description: Extra environment and arguments each kind of agent starts with, in every workspace. `overbridge relaunch` stores a workspace's own settings, applied over these. Root-only, so a branch cannot change how agents start. Builds older than the one that added it reject this key: remove it before downgrading.

mods-dir.description: The folder `overbridge mods` installs Claude Code mods into; every workspace Claude loads each mod in it. Absolute, ~/-relative or relative to the root. Root-only. Default: mods in Claude's config folder (~/.claude/mods).

cpu-priority.description: Whether each workspace's processes get its priority class's nice value and, on macOS, Darwin background. false stops every pass and takes processes out of background; a nice already set stays until the process restarts. Default: true.

priority-classes.description: The workspace priority classes, highest first: they order the check queue, break ties within a Jira priority in the @work list, and set each workspace's CPU priority. Every repo shares them, so the list lives here only. Default: high (nice 1), normal (the default class, nice 5), low (nice 9, Darwin background).

icon.description: Shown on the sidebar card and in the @checks tab; two columns wide, like an emoji.

default.description: The class a claim gets when no rule or repo priority names one. Default: the first class.

nice.description: The nice value of the workspace's processes. 0 is kept for the multiplexer and the sidebars. Default: 1 + 4 × the class's place in the list, capped at 19.

background.description: On macOS, also run the workspace's processes in Darwin background (efficiency cores, throttled disk I/O). Default: false, except for the built-in low class.

github-orgs.description: GitHub owners (users or orgs) the @prs and @reviews tabs search. Leave out to search every owner gh can see.

guard.description: Additions to the workspace guard. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

read-paths.description: Paths under the root that any workspace may read (never write). Absolute or ~/-relative.

deny.description: More Bash commands to block, checked after the built-in rules.

pattern.description: A regular expression matched against the command.

reason.description: Shown to Claude when the command is blocked.

env.description: Environment variables set for the agent, such as CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE: 0.

args.description: Arguments added to the agent's command line, such as --chrome.

mcp-servers.description: Names of the repo's .mcp.json servers that Claude starts without asking. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

check-scope.description: How `overbridge check` treats a command that runs more than the branch changed: `nx run-many` with no -p or a -p list over max-projects, `nx affected --all`, a test or test:unit target or vitest/jest run with no --changed, --related or spec path, and --skip-nx-cache. Only allowed in the root config.yml, so a branch can't loosen it.

mode.description: enforce refuses the command (exit 1); warn prints why and runs it; off skips the check. Default enforce.

max-projects.description: `nx run-many` with a longer -p/--projects list counts as unscoped. Default 5.

buttons.description: Top panel buttons. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

status.description: Run in the worktree on a refresh: with a PR, only when the PR or the buttons changed, the last run is 5 minutes old, or on r; never while gh is rate limited. Prints text, or {"text", "color"}; printing nothing hides the button. Gets OVERBRIDGE_PR_JSON, the path of a file holding the PR view; empty with no PR.

run.description: Run in the worktree, detached, when the button is pressed.

url.description: Opened when the button is pressed. {ws}, {repo}, {branch} and {pr} are filled in.

hooks.description: Shell commands run in the worktree. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

post-add.description: After a repo's worktree is added to a workspace.

post-checkout.description: After overbridge checkout claims a branch or PR.

post-pr.description: After overbridge pr records an open PR.

pre-remove.description: Before overbridge rm; a failure stops it unless --force.
